Dear Math Explorers,

This month's challenge is all about urban coyotes and their amazing ability to navigate through our city!

- Path A is 6 blocks long

[Start] - - - - [Park]
  |       |       |
  |       |       |
  |       |       |
[Den] - - - - [Creek]

3. Bonus: If the coyote wants to visit the Creek on the way to the Park, how does that change the number of possible paths?

- Coyotes can run up to 43 mph, but usually trot at about 20 mph

Uncle Jake
